title: PriTabICL: Differentially Private Tabular In-Context Learning with Task-Aligned Cluster-Wise Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2611.25073v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular in-context learning (TabICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict target records using a handful of labeled demonstrations in their prompts. However, these demonstrations often contain sensitive personal information. Differential privacy (DP) offers principled protection, but noise-based methods introduce substantial noise, distorting the feature-label relationships essential for accurate prediction, especially as data dimensionality grows.   In this work, we study DP data synthesis for generating privacy-preserving TabICL demonstrations. We identify two limitations of directly applying general-purpose DP synthesis to entire datasets: modeling a global distribution can obscure local structure and minority patterns in heterogeneous data, while measuring broad attribute dependencies under a limited privacy budget can reduce the accuracy available for relationships most relevant to prediction. translated_title: PriTabICL：基于任务对齐的簇级合成的差分隐私表格上下文学习
translated_abstract: 表格上下文学习使大语言模型（LLM）能够利用提示中少量带标签的示例来预测目标记录。然而，这些示例通常包含敏感的个人信息。差分隐私（DP）提供了有原则的保护，但基于噪声的方法会引入大量噪声，扭曲对准确预测至关重要的特征-标签关系，尤其是随着数据维度的增长。在本工作中，我们研究用于生成隐私保护TabICL示例的差分隐私数据合成。我们指出了将通用差分隐私合成直接应用于整个数据集的两个局限性：建模全局分布可能掩盖异构数据中的局部结构和少数模式，而在有限的隐私预算下测量广泛的属性依赖关系可能会降低用于与预测最相关的关系的准确性。更广泛地说，全局统计……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PriTabICL，通过任务对齐的簇级差分隐私数据合成来生成隐私保护的表格上下文学习示例，克服了直接对整个数据集应用通用差分隐私合成时全局分布建模掩盖局部结构和有限隐私预算下广泛属性依赖降低预测准确性的两大局限。
